policy: Actual producer/caller ndarrays. Serial kernels, fixed absolute deadlines, original budgets. A correctness regression quarantines candidate and limits its time measurements to exploration. Common support repair and external pins are prerequisites for all timing.
s1: Cold nearest, independent cold scan, same-session reuse, repeat and actual in-memory edit isolated copies. MCP-only is a negative control for H dispatch. Heavy first requests: >=10% median faster where replicated and actual identical outputs are required for a speed claim. Short or warm endpoints: material regression requires a paired median over +5% AND +5 ms. Single observations are descriptive.
s2: 3 light events, common support, 7 rotated complete groups per event; H1 vs H0 target paired median reduction >=10% plus >=5/7 faster on each kernel and event. Functional/control outcomes including true automatic host trust tracked separately.

s3.workload: G60 ordinary private Blender. User asks for inventory and which object lies nearest to Target, plus all contacts within 5 mm. Read the live overview, require Target in returned inventory, then cold new product stdio initialize/list, nearest and same-session scan 0.005, full responses, EOF and exit. No model or simulated clock.
s3.outputs: Validate all per-arm identities, same-host complete reference response from a separate 032 process incl host source/doc/revision and all bytes except runtime identity+per-request trace, every geometrical output and ordering vs fixed prior 040. Keep all raw receipts; no pairing after a missing response.
s3.timing: primary contiguous wall begins immediately before invoking fixed Hook, ends after last geometry receipt and actual product shutdown. Separate to-last-response, hook, child startup, geometry RTT, actual full host launch/QA/teardown envelope. Cold means independent process/session, OS caches not controlled.
s3.threshold: Combined full workflow D/A >=10% paired median reduction and >=5/7 faster; show kernel B/A and D/C, launcher C/A and D/B; standalone Hook and kernel gates required separately for promotion.
s3.statistics: 7 blocks screening only. All observations and median, observed linear p95 descriptive only. Bootstrap paired blocks with replacement, fixed seed 41041 and 20000 replicates; 95% percentile interval on medians, exploratory. For interaction use per-block TD-TB-TC+TA in milliseconds. No formal tail claims or 30-block experiment in this cycle.
s3.resources: Windows Job accounting for owned processes. Separate resource replay (one additional complete block, if possible), avoid polling working sets in primary timing. Include charged Job CPU, RSS/working set at recorded times, private memory, no sum of individual lifetime peaks. Separate full private GUI launch and cleanup, and separate audit replays.

decision: One qualification cycle. No prod promotion or external distribution. When trust or original required semantics cannot be independently confirmed restrict scope. No new worker/algorithm/cache edits.
